messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Redis-kv-cache shard 7: sustained eviction rate > 1200/s, p95 request latency breach (api-text-gen)

alyssa (oncall): paging — seeing spikes in p95/p99 for streaming responses, customers reporting stalls. digging in metrics now. @raj can you grab runtime logs? :phone:

raj (runtime): on it. preliminary: lots of cache evictions + io_wait spikes on nodes backing shard 7. prefill:decode ratio looks off — prefill traffic is small but decode CPU is saturated on the same nodes.

marta (sre): confirming alerts: latency SLOs: p95 -> 310ms (SLO 250ms), p99 -> 1.8s (SLO 1s). Streaming stalls seen as series of 2-5s gaps in chunk delivery.

alyssa (oncall): impact: 3 customers at high severity (chat streaming) - support queue shows 12 tickets. marking incident P2 for now but could escalate if more customers degrade.

dave (support): got one customer on a call, says the streaming UI freezes mid-generation ~30-40% of the time. They see sometimes immediate tail success after retry.

raj (runtime): logs snippet from node-7-02: ```
2026-03-15T10:01:12Z WARN kvcache: eviction triggered: 1350/s
2026-03-15T10:01:13Z ERROR streaming: stall detected, write delayed 2400ms
2026-03-15T10:01:14Z INFO decode: worker queue depth=128, active=64, avg_latency=320ms
```

marta (sre): network looks ok. disk i/o not saturated. this smells like cache fragmentation: small hot sets evicting other entries -> hot-shard thrash, prefill items being evicted before decode reads them. we've seen this pattern before but different shard.

alyssa (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

raj (runtime): propose quick mitigations (in order):
- temporarily lower decode concurrency on shard 7 nodes (reduce active decode workers from 64 -> 16) to relieve CPU and reduce context switching
- increase prefill TTL/weight for in-flight prefix keys so they survive decode latency spikes
- trigger manual shard rebalancing for KV ring to move some keys off node-7-02
- if needed, spin up 1 extra ded-pool (burst capacity) for streaming tier for next 20m

marta (sre): agree. I'll do the rebalancing and coordinate ded-pool. raj, can you roll the decode concurrency change as a runtime flag?

raj (runtime): patching now. command: ```/svc runtime update --shard 7 --flag decode_workers=16 --reason "hot-eviction mitigation"``` (I'm doing a canary on node-7-02 first)

deploy-bot: deploy started for runtime service on node-7-02 (canary) — build 2026.3.15-hotfix-1

alyssa (oncall): doing customer notifications: posting to status page with "partial degradation for streaming responses in region us-west-2; working on mitigation; updates every 15m."

sydney (pm): let me know if any SLA credits or customer outreach needs escalation. prioritize customers on contracts.

raj (runtime): canary looks good (10m): cpu dropped ~28%, eviction rate down to ~350/s on canary node. streaming stalls reduced for traffic hitting canary. rolling to remaining nodes in shard 7.

marta (sre): rebalancer started: moving 12% of keys off node-7-02 -> node-8-01. live migrate with throttling to avoid extra pressure.

alyssa (oncall): metrics after both steps (t+22m): p95 ~ 210ms, p99 ~ 920ms, eviction rate cluster-wide down 60%. streaming stalls reported by tracing decreased to near-baseline but still intermittent.

dave (support): customers reporting much better now. one still sees occasional 2s pause but frequency reduced.

raj (runtime): following up with a small config change to cache heuristics: bump prefill weight for streaming prefixes and lower eviction aggressiveness for items with in-flight decode tag. Will roll as config toggle (no binary deploy).

marta (sre): launched ded-pool extra nodes for 30m window as buffer. cost noted.

alyssa (oncall): handoff note for morning oncall:
- root cause likely KV cache fragmentation + prefill vs decode imbalance on shard 7 leading to hot eviction and CPU decode contention
- mitigations applied: decode concurrency lowered, prefill weight increased, partial key rebalance, extra dedicated pool, config heuristics toggle, canary runtime rollout v2026.3.15-hotfix-1
- current state: p95/p99 back under SLOs but p99 occasionally spikes ~1.2s for brief windows during rebalance. eviction rate stable ~200-400/s
- follow-ups: postmortem to capture longer-term fix (adaptive per-shard eviction, smarter prefill pinning, better shard hot-key detection + autoscaling)

sydney (pm): pls include customer impact summary and ETA for long-term fix in postmortem. prioritize adaptive eviction asap.

raj (runtime): adding reproduction steps to the incident doc: synthetic traffic that mixes small hot prefix writes + staggered decode pulls at r=300 req/s reproduces eviction spike locally. will attach load script.

marta (sre): assigning owners: raj -> runtime fix + test harness, infra -> autoscaler tuning (oncall: @infra-team), alyssa -> postmortem draft + customer notes, sydney -> stakeholder comms.

alyssa (oncall): leaving handoff for @morning-oncall. last check 30m ago, system stable. tagging follow-ups in jira: INF-8243 (postmortem), INF-8244 (adaptive eviction), INF-8245 (shard-hotkey-dashboard).

incident-bot: incident severity downgraded to P3 at 1765555921; notifications paused.

alyssa (oncall): signing off from pager, leaving runbook pointer: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction> and thread notes in incident doc. morning oncall pls re-awaken if p99 > 1.5s for >10m. :wave:
